description: Department of Elections - Elected Mrs. Paranawithanalage Surani Manjula as Vice Chairman of Wattala P/S
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for the office of Vice Chairman in a local government body (Wattala Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with electoral processes and procedures for local authorities, including the declaration of an elected official due to a vacancy caused by non-attendance of meetings. This falls squarely under Election-related matters.
